title: JA Restaurant EmDash 1.0.2 shows the category label of a post as a link only when that category's list page is live, so /pages/chefs no longer links to a 404
steps: S1: From the repo root at the commit under test, run tests/regression/scripts/REG-PR-532-emdash-restaurant-pages-link.mjs: it reads the theme's version, the post view, the list route, the seed and contracts/1.0.2/content-coverage.json.
expect: The theme is 1.0.2 in package.json, template.config.json, artifact.json and the Dockerfile label.
Post.astro links the category only when it is a blog category and its page is live; otherwise the label is bare text (pre-fix: /pages/chefs linked to /pages, which answers 404).
The committed 1.0.2 content coverage audited no failing page and was not cut short (pre-fix: 1.0.1 held on the dead link /pages).
evidence: Measured on a site built from the 1.0.1 package: dead link (404) /pages shown on /pages/chefs. Measured on a Docker-built 1.0.2 site, desktop and phone: no failing page.
